name: solarmorph
title: Solarmorph
description: Control a Dyson Solarcycle Morph lamp over Bluetooth
author: cjse

commands.name: lamp
commands.title: Lamp Controls
commands.description: Show the lamp state and change brightness, colour temperature, modes, and presets

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Lamp
commands.description: Switch the lamp on or off

commands.name: set-brightness
commands.title: Set Lamp Brightness
commands.description: Set the brightness as a percentage

commands.name: set-temperature
commands.title: Set Lamp Colour Temperature
commands.description: Set the colour temperature in Kelvin

commands.name: disconnect
commands.title: Disconnect Lamp
commands.description: Close the Bluetooth connection, so that the MyDyson app can connect to the lamp

commands.name: pair
commands.title: Pair Lamp
commands.description: Get the lamp key from your Dyson account. This is necessary one time.

preferences.name: keepAlive
preferences.title: Keep the Connection Open
preferences.description: How long the background process holds the Bluetooth connection after the last command. While it holds the connection, commands are fast, but the MyDyson app cannot connect to the lamp.
